description:
Activate Throne of Eldraine by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast monoblue spells.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Throne of Eldraine.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as the token enters.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Throne of Eldraine token instead.
